strings.text: The send-off is over, and the morning hasn't come yet.
strings.translation: A despedida acabou, e a manhã ainda não chegou.

strings.text: Five twenty. The cassette is going round for the third time.
strings.translation: Cinco e vinte. A fita está tocando pela terceira vez.

strings.text: At six the UAZ van from the draft office will come for Sery.
strings.translation: Às seis a van UAZ do alistamento militar vem buscar o Siéry.

strings.text: Vitek cracks sunflower seeds and doesn't know what to say. Neither does his mum at the window.
strings.translation: Vitiok quebra sementes de girassol e não sabe o que dizer. Nem a mãe dele, na janela.

strings.text: The draft office's UAZ van rolls out from behind the garages and stops by the entrance. Sharik lifts his head.
strings.translation: A van UAZ do alistamento sai de trás das garagens e para em frente à entrada do prédio. O Charik levanta a cabeça.

strings.text: The van has disappeared behind the garages.
strings.translation: A van sumiu atrás das garagens.
